name: 2N5457
description: General-purpose N-channel JFET common in audio buffers and amp-sim stages. Higher pinch-off and IDSS than the J201, easier to bias. TO-92 lead order is D-S-G.

TO-92.notes: flat face toward you, leads down: D-S-G (pin 1 drain on the left).

typical_application: Source-follower buffers, instrument input stages, JFET preamps. Self-bias with a source resistor sized from the measured IDSS.
gotchas: depletion-mode: conducts at Vgs=0; needs negative Vgs to reduce current
wide IDSS/pinch-off spread between parts; measure or trim for repeatable bias
